messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Semiconductor?

### Short answer
The passages do not rank “most important” capabilities, but the supported signaling-test capability areas for semiconductor/device applications are: multi-RAT cellular signaling, Wi‑Fi signaling, RF TX/RX and pre-conformance measurements, RF impairment/performance testing, application/IP/IMS/audio testing, interworking/offloading, NTN/NB‑NTN validation, automation, and production non-signaling RF test coverage where production is the target phase [2][3][10][11][41][47][79][81].
| Capability area | Supported capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 5G/LTE multi-RAT signaling | CMX500 is a one-box network emulation and measurement solution for device testing, covering LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [2]. | [2] |
| NR/LTE signaling + measurements | CMX500 provides NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, plus LTE signaling and LTE measurements [2]. | [2] |
| Wi‑Fi / WLAN signaling | CMX500 provides WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements covering 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO [2]. | [2] |
| Wi‑Fi 7 R&D signaling | CMX500 is described as a multi-technology, multi-channel signaling tester with integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality for testing wireless devices across cellular and non-cellular standards in a single instrument setup [11]. | [11] |
| Wi‑Fi 7 RF/MLO/MIMO capability | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D tests include signaling-mode RF TX/RX measurements under real-world conditions, MLO-related multiple RF chain testing, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E test capabilities [11]. | [11] |
| RF and receiver performance | CMX500 supports fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement [2]. | [2] |
| RF pre-conformance / design verification | CMX500 provides a 3GPP RF pre-conformance WebGUI solution for selected NR-FR1 SA test cases based on 3GPP TS 38.521-1, positioned for early-stage validation, debugging and step-by-step verification [79]. | [79] |
| RF test groups | Supported NR FR1 SA pre-conformance groups include UE output power, power dynamics/tolerance, modulation quality, spectrum, receiver sensitivity and throughput-related maximum input level testing [81]. | [81] |
| Application/IP services | CMX-KA100 provides internal IP services and IP connection to DUT applications, including DNS, IMS, Message Center, FTP, HTTP, DNS monitor, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard and web server [3]. | [3] |
| QoS, ePDG/N3IWF and delay/IP tuning | CMX-KA110 adds QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement, IP tune tool and SMPP/MT SMS advanced settings [3]. | [3] |
| IP traffic analysis | CMX-KA150 provides an IP analysis tool for monitoring and analyzing DUT uplink/downlink IP traffic [3]. | [3] |
| IMS voice/audio quality | CMX-KA180 provides audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice calls, CMX-KA181 adds POLQA perceived speech quality measurement, and CMX-KA401 supports WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA and end-to-end audio delay [3]. | [3] |
| WLAN/cellular interworking | CMX500 is used for cellular 5G and WLAN traffic offloading and interworking, including WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN using an integrated N3IWF gateway and POLQA voice quality measurement [57]. | [57] |
| NTN / NB‑NTN IoT | A Viasat NB‑NTN IoT certification test plan is based on CMX500, covers protocol, performance and RF test scenarios, and targets chipsets, modules and devices interoperating with the Viasat satellite network and complying with 3GPP Release 17 [41]. | [41] |
| RedCap / IoT device relevance | RedCap is described as a 3GPP Release 17 reduced-functionality 5G technology with lower cost, mid-range throughput, low power consumption, low complexity and IoT attractiveness [85]. | [85] |
| Multi-SIM signaling behavior | CMX500 Multi-SIM testing uses one CMX, one DUT, two SIM slots and two parallel connections to test DSDS/DSDA behavior [19]. | [19] |
| Automation and remote control | CMX500 supports CMsquares GUI, CMXmars message log analysis, CMsequencer graphical scripting, Python-based XLAPI and SCPI remote control [47]. | [47] |
| Production non-signaling RF testing | For WLAN device production, RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and CMP180 is positioned for this production non-signaling RF testing purpose [10]. | [10] |
【推論】For semiconductor teams working on chipsets, modules or devices, the highest-priority signaling-test stack suggested by the passages is cellular NR/LTE signaling, Wi‑Fi signaling, RF performance/pre-conformance, application/IP/IMS validation, and automation, because these are repeatedly described as CMX500 device-testing, R&D signaling, application-test and automation capabilities [2][3][11][47][79][81].

R&S CMX500 › R&S CMX-B200A accelerator unit
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX-B200A]] 提供 accelerated digital signal processing capabilities，並包含 two high-speed digital I/Q interfaces：

| 項目 | 規格 |
|---|---|
| Ports | DIG. IQ HS 1、DIG. IQ HS 2 |
| Direction | full duplex |
| Connector | QSFP+ |
| Level | CML |
| Data rate | 40 Gbps |

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，每個 accelerator unit 可 fading 的最大 cells 數包含：1 NR cell 8x8 MIMO；1 NR cell 16x4 MIMO, 50 MHz bandwidth；2 NR cells 4x4 MIMO；4 NR cells 2x2 MIMO；2 LTE cells 8x4 MIMO；4 LTE cells 2x2 或 4x4 MIMO。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

- [[R&S CMX500]] 5G / Wi‑Fi 配置表未標示依據的正式 configuration guide、軟體版本、license bundle、報價工具版本或 release date。

Signaling test solution › UAV 與通訊技術
- [[UAV 通訊]] — 本來源補充 UAV 產品使用 Radio、Wi‑Fi、LTE、5G、SATCOM、RTK 與 proprietary radio 的例子。
- [[UAV 通訊頻段]] — 本來源新增 DJI O4 / O3+ 專有影像傳輸使用 2.4 / 5.8 GHz 的例子；頻段合規仍需回到地區法規與產品文件確認。

- [[UAV 多技術 De-sense 驗證]] — 來源中的多技術整合驗證線索；目前只有概念性配置原則，未提供 test case、limits 或量測結果。
- [[Radio communication]]、[[Wi-Fi]]、[[LTE]]、[[5G]]、[[SATCOM]]、[[RTK]]、[[MIMO]]、[[EVM]]、[[PER]]、[[BLER]]。

Signaling test solution › 與既有知識的關係
- [[Communication of UAVs]] 已整理 UAV communication 的功能、鏈路、協定、硬體與頻段摘錄；本來源補充具體 UAV 產品例子與 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling test 配置線索。
- [[Communications on UAVs]] 只是 UAV communication / SDR link hub；本來源比該 link hub 多出可抽取的 CMX500 5G / Wi‑Fi 配置表。
- [[R&S CMX500]]、[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 已有正式產品規格與 features 來源；本來源屬於 Market 類 OneNote solution note，適合用於 UAV use-case / configuration discussion，不應取代正式 specifications 或 configuration tool。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 正式 specifications 已支撐 RF unit 400 MHz to 8000 MHz、CMX500 base unit 1201.0002K70、CMX-PB70H 1222.0676.09、CMX-B200A 1222.0747.02、CMX-B300C 1222.0801.04、CMX-B600B 1222.0953.03、CMX-KM600 1222.4013.02 等資料；本來源與這些資料一致，但用途是 UAV signaling solution 摘要。
- [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 已整理 CMX500 OBT 與 Bluetest 的 4G / 5G NR / WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing；本來源較偏向 conducted / signaling configuration 與多技術 De-sense 驗證概念，未提到 OTA chamber。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

R&S CMW500 › 支援技術摘要
- [[R&S CMW500]] 在 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] 中是唯一明確支援 GSM small cell、WCDMA small cell、LTE small cell 的 CMW 型號。
- GSM、NB-IoT、WCDMA、LTE mobile station test 與 NR Sub-6GHz 章節明確標示適用於 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW290]]。
- Four RF paths、DAU B450H/I、Digital I/Q 1 to 4 / 5 to 8、Digital I/Q QUAD 章節明確標示 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW270]]。
- Bluetooth standard：Bluetooth Core Specification Version 5.0；test standard 包含 RF.TS.5.0.0 與 RF-PHY.TS.5.0.0。
- WLAN 160 MHz bandwidth unit 章節列出 IEEE 802.11a/g/p/n/ac 與 IEEE 802.11ax，bandwidth up to 160 MHz。
- [[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 補充 [[NGeCall over LTE]]、[[IMS eCall]]、[[IVS]]、[[PSAP]]、[[MSD]]、limited service、callback、clear-down、SRVCC handover 等 eCall 測試語境。

R&S CMW500 › 規格條件
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。
- 需至少 15 minutes warm-up time，環境溫度與指定 environmental conditions 符合要求，calibration cycle 已遵守，且所有 internal automatic adjustments 已執行。
- `typ.` 為 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 為 design parameters，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Calibration interval：12 months recommended for highest accuracy；24 months 時需在 specified RF generator 與 RF analyzer level uncertainty 加上 0.2 dB。

R&S CMW500 › 重要限制
- 來源明示：[[R&S CMW500]] 有時只支援部分測試，某些測試需要進一步設備。
- 多個 CEN/TS 17240 IVS 測試需要外部 HMI interaction、ignition switched OFF 控制、manufacturer specific AT command、IVS debugging tool、prepared TestUSIM 或 handset；這些不完全由 KA09x software 控制。
- CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available；需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS call-back abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 標示 Not available。
- 來源註明 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 [[NGeCall over LTE]] / IMS 的 transition 尚未由 EU commission 最終決定，因此部分涉及 handover 的 test cases 尚未實作。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing
[[CMX500 use-case based 5G testing]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 market / solution positioning：以 use-case based approach 支援 5G eMBB、FWA、RedCap、NTN、XR 等裝置測試，而不只是一組單點工具。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › Shuffler
來源描述 [[Shuffler]]：

- RF / T-put test on all supported UE band combos in one go。
- All Shuffler tests part of [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] test package。
- Loop blocks provide flexibility to loop through bands、bandwidth、channels。
- one test script with one test report can test RF TX / RX measurement、RX sensitivity measurement、throughput、VoLTE / VoNR。
- Band combinations input via UE capabilities or user-defined Excel sheet。
- Shuffler implemented in [[R&S CMsequencer]]。

此處仍需正式 [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] 文件補證。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › toolchain
來源列出的 CMX500 toolchain 包含：

- [[R&S CMsquares]]。
- [[R&S CONTEST]]。
- Conformance：LTE、NR、2G、3G、C-IoT。
- 測試範圍：RF Conformance、RRM、LBS、NetOp、PCT、signaling tests、application、callbox、NPT、PQA、3GPP RF preconformance、ATE。
- 相關設備：[[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S ATS CATR]]、[[R&S NGM200]]、[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。

CMX500 Multi-SIM testing
[[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中描述的 [[R&S CMX500]] callbox use case：以 1 台 CMX、1 個 DUT、2 個 SIM slots 與 2 條 parallel connections 測試 DSDS / DSDA 多 SIM 行為。[[Dual Sim Dual Active]] 進一步補上 Release 17 / Release 18 [[Multi-USIM operation]] 的 3GPP / RRC / stack-development 背景。

CMX500 Multi-SIM testing › 來源中的 Multi-SIM 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]：

- Multi-SIM enables：1 DUT、2 SIM slots、2 parallel connections、1 CMX（any configuration）。
- 來源列出 two flavors of Multi-SIM：[[DSDS]] 與 [[DSDA]]。
- Option 線索包含 [[R&S CMX-KS600B]] NR Signaling SA/NSA 與 [[R&S CMX-KS613B]] Multi-SIM Enabler。

依 [[Dual Sim Dual Active]]：

- Release 17 standardized solution for NR [[DSDS]]，面向 single-RX/single-TX UEs 與 dual-RX/single-TX UEs。
- Release 18 extends [[Multi-USIM operation]] with [[Dual SIM Dual Active]]，針對 dual-Tx / dual-Rx MUSIM device。
- DSDA 情境中 UE can maintain two [[RRC_CONNECTED]] states simultaneously，但 UE hardware capabilities shared across two SIMs。
- Release 18 DSDA 需要處理 [[MUSIM gap]] priority / keep preference 與 [[Temporary UE capability restriction]]。

CMX500 Multi-SIM testing › DSDA
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，[[DSDA]]（dual SIM dual active）：

- Two TRX。
- 2 SIMs in active connection at a time。

依 [[Dual Sim Dual Active]]，Release 18 DSDA 的 3GPP / stack 背景是：

- dual-Tx / dual-Rx MUSIM UE 可同時維持兩個 [[RRC_CONNECTED]] states。
- UE 可能先連到一個 network，再連到第二個 network。
- UE 可將部分 hardware capabilities 移給第二個 network。
- hardware capability sharing 與 band conflict 可能導致 temporary capability restriction。
- Network A 是 NR，Network B 可以是 E-UTRA 或 NR。

⚠️ [[Dual Sim Dual Active]]（2026-09-24 converted；來源未標示正式日期）說 DSDA 表格列為 answering new call 時 ongoing call is released、DR-DA 才是 ongoing call is kept，但既有頁面 [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]] 說 example use case 中 call on SIM1 on hold 並可回到 SIM1。判斷：可能是 DSDA / DR-DA terminology、call service handling 與 CMX500 demo slide 的層級差異；未回查原 PDF / release note 前不裁決。

WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN › R&S CMX500 測試情境
來源稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將在 [[MWC 2024]] 展示 [[R&S CMX500]] 測試 seamless traffic offloading and interworking between cellular [[5G]] and [[WLAN]] 的能力：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 single box solution。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway。
- [[N3IWF]] gateway 使 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN 測試更 easy-to-use。
- 目標使用者是 device manufacturers 與 operators。
- 來源稱 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 提供 comprehensive and cost-effective solution，用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 early-stage quality of experience assessment。

[[CMX500_Callbox]] 另補充：

- WLAN + Cellular in one box enables Interference / Desense Testing against all LTE/NR bands with real connections。
- EN-DC + WiFi7 is also possible。
- LTE + NR + WiFi Measurements in parallel。
- WiFi example slide 出現 4096QAM 與 320 MHz BW in 6GHz Band。

這些 desense / parallel measurement 內容更完整整理於 [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。

本概念是 [[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 的 interworking / application testing 子情境。來源將它放在 [[R&S CMX500]] 新增 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality 之後，表示 [[R&S CMX500]] 不只測試 WLAN RF / signaling，也可測試 cellular and non-cellular interworking。

[[CMX500_Callbox]] 則把 WLAN / cellular one-box 能力放到 interference / desense 與 EN-DC + WiFi7 parallel measurements 的 R&D use case，與 voice / offloading use case 相鄰但不完全相同。

5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing
[[5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing]] 是在產品開發早期，依 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] 對 [[5G NR]] Range 1 Standalone UE RF transmission / reception behavior 進行簡化驗證的 R&D / design verification 測試流程；目前主要由 [[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 支撐，並由 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 補充 GUI / callbox 簡報層級的 use-case 敘事。

passages.text:
5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing › 與嚴格 conformance testing 的關係
[[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 將本流程定位為 RF pre-conformance / design verification。來源另指出 strict RF conformance testing and validated test cases 可使用 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]，支援 [[3GPP]] UE conformance testing，並涵蓋 demodulation、performance、out-of-band capabilities 的 conformance testing。

因此本頁不可把 WebGUI pre-conformance workflow 視為完整 certification lab procedure，也不可推論其測試結果等同 GCF / PTCRB formal validation。

passages.text:
5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing › Test case 自動化設定
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]：

- Users 可配置 signaling 與 cell-related settings，以符合特定 test objectives。
- Test case 會依 selected test case 與 test ID，自動調整 relevant settings，包括 reference measurement channel（RMC）configurations、UL power control settings 與 additional spectrum emission values。

[[Dual Sim Dual Active]] 列出以下 NR-NR use cases，可作為 CMX500 Multi-SIM 測試情境參考，但來源未明示等同 CMX500 已支援清單：

- Single cell per SIM：SIM1 連 cell A，SIM2 連 cell B，兩邊 data transmission。
- Paging：Page SIM1 on NR cell A、Page SIM2 on NR cell B，並兩邊 data transmission。
- Handover：SIM1 handover to cell C，SIM2 handover to cell D。
- Suspend / Resume：SIM1 / SIM2 suspend and resume；procedures could overlap。
- CA：兩個 SIM 各自配置 PCell / SCells，並同時 data transmission。
- NR-DC：兩個 SIM 各自配置 PCell / PSCell，並同時 data transmission；來源註明 low prio based on customer feedback。
- Both SIMs on the same cell：來源列出但 current NR stack does not support this use case。

CMX500 Multi-SIM testing › Example use case
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 example use case：

1. Ongoing MT call on SIM1。
2. Incoming call received。
3. Change to call on SIM2。
4. Call on SIM1 on hold。
5. Go back to call on SIM1。

來源註明：DSDS takes longer as more signaling involved（RRC + IMS）。

CMX500 Multi-SIM testing › DSDS
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，[[DSDS]]（dual SIM dual standby）：

- One TX, 2 RX（typical）。
- 2 SIMs in standby。
- One SIM in active connection at a time。
- 可 listen for paging with 2nd RX。

依 [[Dual Sim Dual Active]]，DSDS 是 Release 17 MUSIM base feature；來源表格說當 UE 在一個 network 上通話時，另一個 network 不能接收 voice call，也不能 data transmission。Dual Receive DSDS 則可接收另一個 network 的 incoming call，但若接聽新 call，ongoing call released。

CMX500 Multi-SIM testing › Supported combinations
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 來源列出：

- 5G + 5G（DSDS / DSDA）。
- 4G + 5G（DSDS / DSDA）。
- LTE + LTE（DSDS）。
- LTE + LTE（DSDA）在不同 slide 中一處列為 supported，另一處列為 coming soon。

[[Dual Sim Dual Active]] 補充：

- 該來源的 use case analysis 只分析 NR-NR use cases。
- 來源說 NR-LTE use cases have no impact on NR stack since a single NR connection is needed。
- DSDA can be combined with CA and NR-DC。

CMX500 Multi-SIM testing › unresolved
- [[CMX500_Callbox]]：Slide 42 與 Slide 69 對 LTE + LTE DSDA 的狀態可能不同：一處列在 supported combinations，一處寫 coming soon；需回原始簡報或 release note 確認時點與 scope。
- [[CMX500_Callbox]]：來源未列出 [[R&S CMX-KS613B]] 的 order number、software release、支持的 IMS / voice / data / paging matrix 或 DUT capability requirements。
- [[CMX500_Callbox]]：來源未說明 `1 CMX any configuration` 是否仍受 hardware units、RF paths、carrier aggregation、mobility 或 application testing option 限制。
- [[Dual Sim Dual Active]]：來源未標示正式發布日期、文件版次、3GPP CR 或規格版本。
- [[Dual Sim Dual Active]]：是否支援 same physical cell ID and same ARFCN 是來源明示 open point，需要 customer clarification。

WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN
[[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的 single-box interworking 測試情境：用 [[R&S CMX500]] 測試 cellular 5G 與 [[WLAN]] 之間的 traffic offloading、voice call handover 與 voice quality；[[CMX500_Callbox]] 另以 callbox 簡報方式把 WLAN offloading、ATSSS、desense 與 LTE / NR / WiFi parallel measurements 放在 application / interference test use cases 中。

- [[RF pre-conformance testing]] 又稱 design verification，應在產品開發早期開始，用於及早找出並處理問題。

- Test case procedures 針對 R&D use cases 最佳化，使用 specification 中最相關的 configurations。
- Application note 中的 procedures 可能相較 [[3GPP]] specification 更 streamlined 或 simplified，以提供 intuitive、user-friendly interface，同時產生 meaningful RF pre-conformance results。
- Pre-conformance testing 目標是在基於 [[3GPP]] specification 的 streamlined procedure 中提供 meaningful results，但不嚴格遵循所有 parameters。

來源對 [[RedCap]] / [[5G RedCap]] 的定義：

- [[3GPP Release 17]] defined 5G technology。
- reduced-functionality version of 5G。
- significantly lower cost compared to [[5G eMBB]]。
- mid-range data throughput。
- low power consumption。
- low complexity。
- ability to support a large number of devices。
- particularly attractive for [[IoT]] applications。

本頁只記錄來源中的 solution-level 說法；不推論 RedCap UE category、band support、3GPP test case coverage、RF measurements、protocol conformance 或 certification scope。

[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）描述的架構為：

- [[Bluetest Flow]] control software / integrated test environment 整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS），例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，提供 reverberation chamber OTA environment。
- 測試對象為 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。
- 測試目標為 MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[Bluetest]] expanded its earlier integrated testing capabilities for [[WLAN]] stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] 現在支援 bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。
- 此能力與 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 [[Bluetest]] RTS 組成 single tester and reverberation test system 的 integrated path。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可 combined with the latest sophisticated testing features of [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 整合 enables support of [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 non-cellular technologies including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- [[EMITE]] customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] as well as [[5G RedCap]] devices。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 是在 over-the-air、signaling mode 與 realistic multipath RF conditions 下，對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 的 antenna、RF transmitter / receiver 與 multi-antenna performance 進行壓力測試的測試情境。新匯入的 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 補充另一個 partner integration 視角：[[EMITE]] OTA chambers 可整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 最新測試能力，用於 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] device performance assessment。

### Short answer
The passages do not rank “most important” capabilities, but the supported signaling-test capability areas for semiconductor/device applications are: multi-RAT cellular signaling, Wi‑Fi signaling, RF TX/RX and pre-conformance measurements, RF impairment/performance testing, application/IP/IMS/audio testing, interworking/offloading, NTN/NB‑NTN validation, automation, and production non-signaling RF test coverage where production is the target phase [2][3][10][11][41][47][79][81].
| Capability area | Supported capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 5G/LTE multi-RAT signaling | CMX500 is a one-box network emulation and measurement solution for device testing, covering LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [2]. | [2] |
| NR/LTE signaling + measurements | CMX500 provides NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, plus LTE signaling and LTE measurements [2]. | [2] |
| Wi‑Fi / WLAN signaling | CMX500 provides WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements covering 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO [2]. | [2] |
| Wi‑Fi 7 R&D signaling | CMX500 is described as a multi-technology, multi-channel signaling tester with integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality for testing wireless devices across cellular and non-cellular standards in a single instrument setup [11]. | [11] |
| Wi‑Fi 7 RF/MLO/MIMO capability | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D tests include signaling-mode RF TX/RX measurements under real-world conditions, MLO-related multiple RF chain testing, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E test capabilities [11]. | [11] |
| RF and receiver performance | CMX500 supports fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement [2]. | [2] |
| RF pre-conformance / design verification | CMX500 provides a 3GPP RF pre-conformance WebGUI solution for selected NR-FR1 SA test cases based on 3GPP TS 38.521-1, positioned for early-stage validation, debugging and step-by-step verification [79]. | [79] |
| RF test groups | Supported NR FR1 SA pre-conformance groups include UE output power, power dynamics/tolerance, modulation quality, spectrum, receiver sensitivity and throughput-related maximum input level testing [81]. | [81] |
| Application/IP services | CMX-KA100 provides internal IP services and IP connection to DUT applications, including DNS, IMS, Message Center, FTP, HTTP, DNS monitor, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard and web server [3]. | [3] |
| QoS, ePDG/N3IWF and delay/IP tuning | CMX-KA110 adds QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement, IP tune tool and SMPP/MT SMS advanced settings [3]. | [3] |
| IP traffic analysis | CMX-KA150 provides an IP analysis tool for monitoring and analyzing DUT uplink/downlink IP traffic [3]. | [3] |
| IMS voice/audio quality | CMX-KA180 provides audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice calls, CMX-KA181 adds POLQA perceived speech quality measurement, and CMX-KA401 supports WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA and end-to-end audio delay [3]. | [3] |
| WLAN/cellular interworking | CMX500 is used for cellular 5G and WLAN traffic offloading and interworking, including WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN using an integrated N3IWF gateway and POLQA voice quality measurement [57]. | [57] |
| NTN / NB‑NTN IoT | A Viasat NB‑NTN IoT certification test plan is based on CMX500, covers protocol, performance and RF test scenarios, and targets chipsets, modules and devices interoperating with the Viasat satellite network and complying with 3GPP Release 17 [41]. | [41] |
| RedCap / IoT device relevance | RedCap is described as a 3GPP Release 17 reduced-functionality 5G technology with lower cost, mid-range throughput, low power consumption, low complexity and IoT attractiveness [85]. | [85] |
| Multi-SIM signaling behavior | CMX500 Multi-SIM testing uses one CMX, one DUT, two SIM slots and two parallel connections to test DSDS/DSDA behavior [19]. | [19] |
| Automation and remote control | CMX500 supports CMsquares GUI, CMXmars message log analysis, CMsequencer graphical scripting, Python-based XLAPI and SCPI remote control [47]. | [47] |
| Production non-signaling RF testing | For WLAN device production, RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and CMP180 is positioned for this production non-signaling RF testing purpose [10]. | [10] |
【推論】For semiconductor teams working on chipsets, modules or devices, the highest-priority signaling-test stack suggested by the passages is cellular NR/LTE signaling, Wi‑Fi signaling, RF performance/pre-conformance, application/IP/IMS validation, and automation, because these are repeatedly described as CMX500 device-testing, R&D signaling, application-test and automation capabilities [2][3][11][47][79][81].

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

CMX500 Multi-SIM testing
[[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中描述的 [[R&S CMX500]] callbox use case：以 1 台 CMX、1 個 DUT、2 個 SIM slots 與 2 條 parallel connections 測試 DSDS / DSDA 多 SIM 行為。[[Dual Sim Dual Active]] 進一步補上 Release 17 / Release 18 [[Multi-USIM operation]] 的 3GPP / RRC / stack-development 背景。

Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite › 重點摘要
- [[Viasat]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] joined forces，以 boost testing for [[Narrowband Non-terrestrial Networks]]（[[NB-NTN]]）[[IoT]] devices connecting via satellite。
- 合作目標是 thoroughly validating devices，並確認 devices 與 [[Viasat]] network 的 interoperability，以支援 satellite-based [[IoT]] applications 的 uninterrupted connectivity。
- 來源稱雙方正在 strengthen and expand testing for [[Non-Terrestrial Network]] capabilities，specifically for [[NB-IoT]] devices。
- 測試目標包含 chipsets、modules and devices interoperate seamlessly with [[Viasat]] satellite network，並 comply with [[3GPP Release 17]] standards。
- 來源說 advanced testing methodologies 用於 uphold quality、performance and reliability，服務情境是 areas without terrestrial network coverage 的 ubiquitous IoT applications。
- [[Viasat NB-NTN IoT test plan]] 被描述為 certification test plan，涵蓋 protocol、performance 與 RF test scenarios。
- Test plan based on [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester；來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 是 versatile solution designed for testing various NTN technologies，包括 [[NR-NTN]] 與 [[NB-NTN]]。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 在 single instrument 中 covers R&D through certification and carrier acceptance tests，並提供 reliable and repeatable results；此為 PR claim，不能替代 formal specifications。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將於 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] 展示 first test results covering protocol、performance and RF test scenarios，地點為 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] booth 5A80 in hall 5，日期 March 2 to 5, 2026。
- 來源也列出 [[Viasat]] booth：hall 6，booth 6A20。
- Press & media contact 為 [[Christian Mokry]]，職稱 PR Manager Test & measurement，phone +49 89 412913052，email press@rohde-schwarz.com。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing › 來源定義與範圍
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- 主題是 **Simplifying 5G NR 3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing**，副標為 SA Mode According to 3GPP 38.521-1。
- [[RF pre-conformance testing]] 又稱 design verification，應在產品開發早期開始，用於及早找出並處理問題。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 3GPP RF pre-conformance WebGUI solution 提供執行 **NR-FR1 Standalone（SA）** test cases 的平台，依據 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] specification。
- Manual verification capabilities 適合 early-stage validation、debugging 與 step-by-step verification。
- Test case procedures 針對 R&D use cases 最佳化，使用 specification 中最相關的 configurations。
- Application note 中的 procedures 可能相較 [[3GPP]] specification 更 streamlined 或 simplified，以提供 intuitive、user-friendly interface，同時產生 meaningful RF pre-conformance results。
- Pre-conformance testing 目標是在基於 [[3GPP]] specification 的 streamlined procedure 中提供 meaningful results，但不嚴格遵循所有 parameters。

依 [[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- 同一文件編號 1C111 Version 0e 已描述以 [[R&S CMX500]] WebGUI 執行 selected [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] NR-FR1 SA test cases 的 setup、configuration、execution 與 verification。
- Version 0e 使用 R&D RF conformance / pre-conformance 語境；Version 1e 進一步以 pre-conformance / design verification 作為標題與定位。

依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]（投影片日期標示 05.01.2026，格式未標示；converted 2026-09-17）：

- [[R&S CMX500]] callbox focus 包含 RF Testing incl. 3GPP pre-conf。
- CMsquares / WebGUI 中有 one-click RF testing 與 RF SA Preconformance use case。
- 簡報以「Get started with manual 3GPP RF Conformance in seconds」描述 manual GUI workflow。
- 來源稱 RF SA Preconformance 具 automatic configuration of parameters per TC、25 TCs、dynamic workspace per TC。
- 來源稱 comprehensive App Note available on release，包含 step by step instructions for all test cases、tables for verification、example for every TC，並指向 `https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/appnote/1C111`。

來源列出的 selected RF pre-conformance test cases 可分為：

- UE output power：maximum output power、MPR、A-MPR、configured transmitter power、minimum output power。

- Modulation quality：frequency error、[[EVM]] PUCCH/PUSCH、carrier leakage、in-band emissions、EVM equalizer spectrum flatness。
- Spectrum：occupied bandwidth、spectrum emission mask、additional spectrum emission mask、NR ACLR、UTRA ACLR。
- Receiver / throughput：reference sensitivity power level、maximum input level。
